assets.name: ring-3
assets.prompt: Extract ONLY ONE narrow slate-silver elliptical armillary band, tilted diagonally from upper RIGHT to lower LEFT, steeper than 45 degrees. Engraved silver band, charcoal shaded underside, same antique hermetic pixel style. Center 128,128, within 220px diameter. No star or rays. Transparent 256x256.
